description: Adds Playlist bulk remove: select several videos in a playlist you own and remove them in one request. Built to sit alongside the official bundle rather than replace it.

patches.name: Playlist bulk remove
patches.description: Adds checkboxes to playlists you own so several videos can be removed at once.

release_notes:
Fixes scrolling from the checkbox column, and makes a failed removal say what went wrong.

### Scrolling

Dragging from a checkbox did nothing. The overlay claimed the whole checkbox gutter the moment you pressed, and then held on to every movement, so the list only scrolled if your finger happened to start on the thumbnail or the title.

A press that travels past the system's drag threshold now gives up on being a tap and hands the gesture to the list, which receives the press it never saw so the scroll starts from the right place. Tapping a checkbox still ticks it.

### Failed removals

Removals are sent in chunks, and the server takes a chunk all or nothing. One entry it refused therefore reported every other entry in that chunk as failed as well. A chunk that fails is now retried one entry at a time, so the entries the server was happy with go through and the failure count is the real one. The extra requests happen only for a chunk that had already failed.

The request also knew exactly why a removal had failed and threw it away, showing one flat "Could not remove the selected videos" for everything from an expired credential to a dropped connection. The reason now reaches the message:

- `Could not remove the selected videos: HTTP 401`
- `Removed 3 videos, 2 failed: timed out`

A 401 there means the credentials the app handed over had gone stale, which previously took a logcat to tell apart from the playlist refusing the edit.

### Known issue

Removing a video while the playlist page is open leaves its row on screen with a greyed out checkbox, until YouTube refetches the page. The video really is gone from the playlist; the row is stale and the dead checkbox is the overlay declining to act on a video it can no longer identify. Leave the playlist and come back to see the real contents.

### Notes

- Built and tested against YouTube `21.13.164`.
- Meant to be applied **alongside** the official bundle, not instead of it.
- The feature is always on; there is no settings toggle yet.
- Derived from MorpheApp/morphe-patches, GPLv3.
